objective: Validate and normalize World Model state-affecting WorldEvent payloads through one shared typed contract before persistence, replay, or state mutation, preventing malformed Observation and ActionResult values from becoming WorldState facts.
decision_supported: Can the World Model fail closed on malformed Observation and ActionResult payloads while preserving the #56 Motion evidence persistence path without changing public interfaces or shared contracts?
acceptance: One World Model-owned event_payloads module defines the state-affecting Observation and ActionResult payload rules used by the event store, reducer, replay path and Motion evidence adapter; validation rules are not independently duplicated in those consumers.

Observation entity_id is a required non-empty string, location is either absent or a non-empty string, and confidence is a required JSON number that is not bool, NaN or Infinity and is within the inclusive range zero through one.
Observation confidence numeric zero, one and finite values between them are accepted and normalized to float without accepting numeric strings or other broad coercions.

Observation attributes are optional strict string-to-string mappings with at most 32 entries, non-empty keys no longer than 64 characters, non-empty values no longer than 256 characters, and canonical UTF-8 JSON size no greater than 4096 bytes.
Nested dictionaries, lists, nulls, booleans, numeric attribute values, empty attribute keys or values, excessive cardinality, excessive key or value length and excessive serialized size fail closed.
Observation metadata not consumed as a WorldState fact may be preserved, but it cannot bypass validation of entity_id, location, confidence or attributes.

ActionResult payloads are parsed through a strict World Model specialization of the existing workbench_contracts.ActionResult model, with non-empty result_id, action_id and run_id and without modifying libs/contracts.

ActionResult payload run_id must equal WorldEvent run_id; the Motion ExecutionEvent action_id must equal the ActionResult action_id; ActionResult evidence_refs must exactly equal the enclosing WorldEvent evidence_refs after normalization.
This Packet does not invent a minimum ActionResult evidence count or evidence URI syntax that is absent from the existing shared contract.

A completed ActionResult may contain both entity_id and resulting_location or neither; only the paired form may reach the existing spatial mutation path. A non-completed ActionResult cannot declare resulting_location.
SQLiteEventStore.append and append_allocated reject invalid state-affecting payloads before a row is inserted or a sequence transaction is committed.
SQLiteEventStore.list_run validates state-affecting payloads during replay and fails closed if a legacy or externally inserted row contains a malformed payload.
reduce_events validates the complete unique ordered stream before the first apply_event call, so a malformed later event cannot produce or expose a partially reduced state.
apply_event independently validates a directly supplied event before copying or mutating WorldState and uses typed fields without broad str or float conversion.
The former NaN reproduction fails during payload validation, so invalid confidence cannot reach verify_kit_contents or verify_inspection_evidence and cannot produce confirmed.

The #56 MotionEvidenceAdapter uses the shared ActionResult payload validator while preserving MotionEvidenceValidationError at its external boundary, deterministic event identity, atomic sequence allocation and stable evidence references.
The actual read-only workbench_motion.evidence.ExecutionEvent integration path still persists, replays and resolves a valid complete ActionResult.
tools/scripts/demo_scripted.py emits a complete typed ActionResult payload so make demo-scripted and make check do not depend on the rejected legacy three-field action-result shape.
Issue #150 spatial-truth semantics are explicitly deferred: this Packet validates ActionResult payloads but does not claim that action execution evidence is sufficient observation evidence.
No interfaces, shared contracts, Motion, firmware, simulation, hardware, safety configuration or database schema is modified.

A new or updated automated test does not fail for the expected missing-validation reason before implementation.

risks_and_fallbacks: The provisional attributes limits are an internal World Model ingestion policy, not a canonical Observation or WorldState contract; Issue #168 may replace them after cross-owner schema approval.

The Python ActionResult model currently contains entity_id and resulting_location fields that are absent from action_result.schema.json. This Packet relies on the existing Python model used by #56 but does not claim schema parity.
Existing persisted databases containing legacy minimal Observation or ActionResult payloads will fail closed during replay. This Packet does not migrate or silently coerce those rows.
Issue #150 remains open, so a valid completed ActionResult may still update spatial state after this Packet; that known semantic risk is neither hidden nor fixed here.
Updating tools/scripts/demo_scripted.py is a producer migration outside the World Model package and therefore requires Integration Owner review before this Packet is approved.

The repository-local robot/control/.venv contains symbolic links that can make existing Task Packet validation tests fail. If encountered during full checks, temporarily relocate that directory outside the repository, run the checks, restore it exactly, and verify git status; do not weaken this Packet or modify unrelated packets to hide the environment condition.
